en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a very large Neo‑Gothic / historicist building with corner towers, steep roofs and many small dormers, seen from across an open, almost empty field. Leafless trees and a fence run along the foreground in front of the complex. A few small human figures walk in the field, and a tall church spire with a clock is visible in the distance on the right.
